messages:
Rae (AE): Heads up — CoastalAI asking for a 6mo pilot on Private with 30% off + waive onboarding. They want PO by Mon.
June (RevOps): what's list for their config?
Rae (AE): Private VPC, 2xA100 equiv reserved, premium support = $130k/mo. 30% => $91k/mo.
Owen (Security): they submitted a heavy security addendum and are requesting reduced logging and limited audit access. not a straight yes.
Kai (Eng): we can spin up on shared infra for a fast start, migrate to dedicated in ~10 business days. If we waive onboarding fee, we need to limit "expedited work" guarantees.
Rae (AE): proposing two options to buyer tonight:
Option 1: 25% off for 6mo pilot, onboarding fee waived, conversion window 45d — conversion credit = 50% of pilot invoices applied as dollar credit to first post-conversion invoice (cap $150k).
Option 2: 18% off for 12mo commit, $20k onboarding credit, and $12.5k/mo compute-offset credits for pilot spikes.
June (RevOps): finance floor = 20% for pilots without a firm conversion. 25% requires deal-desk signoff + hard PO deadline and security attestation.
Rae (AE): can we make 25% conditional on: 1) PO by Mon EOD (3625000030), 2) signed conversion intent during pilot, 3) security attestation uploaded within 7 days?
Owen (Security): yes, attach the clause: "Onboarding fee waiver contingent on receipt of completed security attestation and network allowlist within 7 days; service start subject to review."
DealDesk: conditional approval possible. Please include explicit credit cap, PO deadline, and revert clause in ticket.
June (RevOps): I will file the deal-desk ticket with conditional approval and margin guardrails. If any condition fails, discount voids and standard pricing applies.
Rae (AE): cool — I'll send the term sheet with those clauses. buyer said procurement will try for Mon but not 100% sure. will update. :crossed_fingers:
